scripts.dev: test -f dist/Neustift-Regular.woff2 || bun run font && bun tools/dev.ts
scripts.font: bun tools/export-font.ts && uv run tools/build_font.py && uv run tools/test_font.py
scripts.web: bun run font && rm -rf web && bun build ./index.html ./font.html --outdir web --minify && cp dist/Neustift-Regular.otf dist/Neustift-Regular.woff2 OFL.txt public/* web/
